description: This file defines a Python class GeminiFileAPI that provides an asynchronous client for interacting with Google's Gemini File API. It includes methods for uploading files, fetching metadata, listing files, and deleting files. The class handles the specifics of the Gemini API's resumable upload protocol and file management.

classes.name: GeminiFileAPI
classes.description: Client class for managing files through the Gemini File API, including uploading, retrieving metadata, listing, and deleting files asynchronously.

methods.name: __init__( self, api_key: str, base_url: str = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/files" )
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiFileAPI client with an API key and optional base URL.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] upload_file( self, file_path: str, display_name: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Uploads a file to the Gemini File API using a resumable upload protocol, returning file metadata.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_file(self, name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified file from the Gemini API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_files( self, page_size: int = 10, page_token: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Lists files uploaded to the Gemini API with pagination support.

methods.name: bool delete_file(self, name: str)
methods.description: Deletes a specified file from the Gemini API.
